reviews.shade: Anua Vitamin C Niacin Tone Up Blemish Pad 60P
reviews.text: I’m buying this for the second time and absolutely love it. The pads are generously soaked in serum, and you can really notice the fresh vitamin C scent, which makes it feel like the concentration is quite high. My skin feels smooth, hydrated, and looks more even-toned after every use. It gives a healthy glow and works great under makeup as well. Definitely a product I’ll keep repurchasing again and again!
reviews.zh: 第二次回購，絕對愛上咗佢。化妝棉充份浸透精華，可以聞到清新嘅維他命C香味，感覺濃度好高。每次用完之後，皮膚感覺光滑水潤，膚色亦更加均勻。俾到健康嘅光澤，妝前用都好啱。一定會不斷回購嘅產品！

reviews.shade: Anua Vitamin C Niacin Tone Up Blemish Pad 60P
reviews.text: I still haven’t use it because l need to finish other pad but l heard a good view it
reviews.zh: 仲未開始用，因為我要先用完其他化妝棉先，但聽過好多好評。

reviews.shade: Anua Vitamin C Niacin Tone Up Blemish Pad 60P
reviews.text: Great Vita C pads. I love these pads. It is part of my morning skin care. These pads are a great alternative for everyone with a sensitive skin but wants to start using vitamin C.
reviews.zh: 超正嘅維他命C化妝棉。我好鍾意呢啲化妝棉，佢已經成為我早上護膚程序嘅一部分。對於敏感肌但又想開始用維他命C嘅人嚟講，呢啲化妝棉係絕佳嘅選擇。

reviews.shade: Anua Vitamin C Niacin Tone Up Blemish Pad 60P
reviews.text: I usually have really horrible acne, but this has cleared my skin up greatly! Even when I skip a day, my acne has still been under control after using this. I’m very satisfied with the results and would recommend this to anyone who may struggle with acne!
reviews.zh: 我平時暗瘡問題好嚴重，但用咗呢款產品之後皮膚大幅改善！就算偶然停一日唔用，暗瘡都keep得到控制。對效果非常滿意，會推薦畀任何受暗瘡困擾嘅人。

reviews.shade: Anua Vitamin C Niacin Tone Up Blemish Pad 60P
reviews.text: I wanted to incorporate Vitamin C into my skin, but I was worried about the unique smell and stickiness of Vitamin C serum, making it difficult to use, so I bought this one. It's insanely easy to use! I don't mind the smell or stickiness at all, and I like the pad because it's easy to use
reviews.zh: 本來想加入維他命C護膚，但一直擔心維他命C精華嘅獨特味道同黏笠感會難用，所以買咗呢款。點知超級易用！完全唔介意個味道同黏笠感，而且化妝棉呢個形式用落好方便。

reviews.shade: Anua Vitamin C Niacin Tone Up Blemish Pad 60P
reviews.text: I’ve been using the Anua Vitamin C Niacin Tone Up Blemish Pads for a few weeks now, and I’m impressed with the results. The pads feel soft and gentle on my skin, and they help brighten my complexion while reducing redness and blemishes. I love that they are easy to use and don’t leave any sticky residue. My skin feels refreshed and smoother after each use. Definitely a great addition to my skincare routine!
reviews.zh: 用咗 Anua Vitamin C Niacin Tone Up Blemish Pads 幾個星期，效果令我好滿意。化妝棉用落柔軟溫和，有助提亮膚色、減退泛紅同瑕疵。我好鍾意佢易用而且唔會留低黏笠殘留感。每次用完皮膚都感覺煥然一新，更加光滑。絕對係護膚程序嘅一大加分！

reviews.shade: Anua Vitamin C Niacin Tone Up Blemish Pad 60P
reviews.text: These pads are super convenient and gentle! They help brighten my skin tone and reduce redness from blemishes. My skin feels refreshed and smoother after every use. Great for daily care!
reviews.zh: 呢啲化妝棉超方便又溫和！有助提亮膚色，減退瑕疵引起嘅泛紅。每次用完皮膚都感覺煥然一新、更光滑。非常適合日常護膚！

reviews.shade: Anua Vitamin C Niacin Tone Up Blemish Pad 60P
reviews.text: こちらのパッドはまだ使用していませんが、これの個包装のシートマスクがすごく良かったのでパッドも気になって購入しました。シートマスクの方はしっとりぷるぷる肌になってワントーン明るくなりました。敏感肌なのでビタミン系は避けているのですが、こちらは多少ピリつくものの赤くなったりかぶれたりしなかったので良かったです！なかにピンが収納できるところもグッドです！
reviews.zh: 呢款化妝棉仲未開始用，不過佢嘅獨立包裝面膜用落超好，所以對化妝棉都有興趣而買咗。嗰款面膜用完皮膚變得水潤飽滿，膚色白咗一度。我係敏感肌，本來會避免維他命類產品，但呢款雖然有少少刺感，卻冇泛紅或者敏感，好正！入面可以收埋夾子嘅設計都好加分！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
